sections.heading: EVENT DATA
sections.text: Choose a season and event code to load registered teams and scored matches from FIRST Events. Before an event starts, preview registered teams using their historical FTCScout OPR.

sections.heading: PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS
sections.text: Compare OPR estimates for overall, Auto, Teleop and Endgame contributions. Explore upcoming matches and custom four-team matchups using OPRc.

sections.heading: SCOUTING TOOLS
sections.text: Sort rankings, open full-event charts and inspect score breakdowns. Save color-coded team tags locally on your Mac.

note: 300 dpi describes the raster export grid; generated artwork retains its native detail. No bleed added.
